value.rationale: The 2024 adaptive-SDC construction uses this estimator to control steps. The theorem gives a complete natural positive-step nonlinear failure locus, shows that all stage values may remain in the physical interval, proves uniqueness of the physical stage solution at a rational witness, and exhibits a sharp absolute endpoint error approaching \(3/4\) under an exactly zero error signal. This quantifies the absence of an unconditional reliability bound for the specified embedded indicator, rather than merely restating interpolation theory.
